map.输入面料幅宽、排料长度与所有样片总面积，计算裁片在布料上的排版利用率（有效面积占: Enter fabric width, nesting length and total sample piece area to compute layout utilisation (effective area share), helping optimise marker planning and reduce waste for pre-cutting material efficiency.
map.排料后核算布料利用率，优化单耗降本: Recompute fabric utilisation after nesting to optimise unit consumption and cut cost
map.不同幅宽/件数方案对比，选利用率最高者: Compare width/piece-count options and pick the highest utilisation
map.利用率低于阈值时调整排料或换窄幅布: When utilisation falls below the threshold, adjust the nesting or switch to narrower fabric
map.：布料 1.5 m × 2 m = 3 m²，裁片净面积合计 2.55 m² →: : fabric 1.5 m × 2 m = 3 m², net piece area totals 2.55 m² → utilisation = 2.55 / 3 = 85% (good).
map.：同版型用 150 cm 幅宽利用率 85%、用 120 cm 幅宽降至 72%: : the same pattern gives 85% utilisation at 150 cm width and drops to 72% at 120 cm — narrower fabric is cheaper per metre but unit consumption rises, so price holistically.
map.一般裁床利用率 80%–90%，格料/对花偏低；低于 80% 应重排或审版型。: A typical cutting-table utilisation is 80%–90%, lower for checked and matched patterns; below 80% the layout should be redone or the pattern reviewed.
map.利用率和单耗什么关系？: What is the relationship between utilisation and unit consumption?
map.单耗 = 布面积 / (件数 × 利用率)，利用率越高单耗越低、成本越低。: Unit consumption = fabric area / (pieces × utilisation); higher utilisation means lower unit consumption and lower cost.
